remarks: Newly renovated 3 bedroom/2 bathroom apartment for rent in Wilton, CT. Enjoy this spacious and never been lived-in apartment that features 1820 square foot of beautifully designed living space, including an office that is ideal for working from home. Relax in your huge living room with adjacent dining room with gas fireplace, or sit outside on your covered porch while enjoying your morning coffee. Apartment has a washer/dryer and public water. Ample onsite parking included in rent. Professionally managed by landlord.   Pet Policy: Breed and weight restrictions. No aggressive breeds and max weight of 50 pounds. Max 2 pets with $60 per pet rent per month. Service animals permitted without additional rent and with document from a healthcare professional.
